newsitem.title: UK: Commercial Union slips, profits disappoint.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Union slips, profits disappoint.

text.p: Shares in UK insurer Commercial Union Plc fell on Wednesday after reporting first quarter pre-tax profits in the middle of analysts forecast range, dealers said.
Commercial Union's shares dropped 12p to 737-1/2p by 0728 GMT in pre-market trading.
"The underlying figures look pretty good but you could say the results are fairly boring with no real features," said Kevin Ryan, insurance analyst at Nikko Europe.
One market-maker agreed the results failed to excite the market but said the fall in the share price was exacerbated by the illiquidity of the market.
"The problem is that some market-makers don't seem to be allowed to run positions and as soon as they buy stock, they just reverse the quote," said the market-maker.
"This market is not as liquid as it should be."
